description: Create remaining Content/AdSense starters (IDs 38-50): astro-affiliate-site, nextjs-directory-site, nextjs-programmatic-seo, nextjs-tools-site, nextjs-job-board, nuxt-magazine-site, nuxt-local-directory, eleventy-static-site, hugo-content-site, astro-recipe-site, astro-comparison-site, nextjs-coupon-site, nextjs-real-estate-directory. Follow astro-adsense-blog as Astro reference and nextjs-supabase-saas for Next.js patterns.
steps: Create astro-affiliate-site (ID 38): Astro + MDX + schema.org structured data + affiliate links + AdSense. Follow astro-adsense-blog pattern with src/ (content/, pages/, components/, layouts/, lib/, seo/), tests/ (unit/, output/). Content collections for product reviews and comparisons.

Create nextjs-directory-site (ID 39): Next.js App Router + Supabase Postgres/Drizzle + Meilisearch + AdSense. Structure: app/ (listings/, categories/, search/), lib/ (server/, search/), domain/, tests/. Fake adapter for search (meilisearch-fake.ts).

Create nextjs-programmatic-seo (ID 40): Next.js App Router + PostgreSQL/Drizzle + Inngest + AdSense. Structure: app/ ([...slug]/ dynamic routes, api/), lib/ (server/, seo/), domain/, tests/. Fake for background jobs.

Create nextjs-tools-site (ID 41): Next.js + static typed data + AdSense + analytics. Structure: app/ (tools/[slug]/, categories/), lib/ (tools/, analytics/), data/, tests/. No database needed - tools defined as typed data files.

Create nextjs-job-board (ID 42): Next.js App Router + Clerk + PostgreSQL/Drizzle + Stripe paid listings + AdSense. Structure: app/ (jobs/, post/, dashboard/), lib/ (server/), domain/, tests/. Fake adapters for auth and billing.

Create nuxt-magazine-site (ID 43): Nuxt + Nuxt Content Markdown + AdSense + image optimization + Resend newsletter. Structure: content/, pages/, components/, layouts/, server/ (api/), composables/, tests/. Use vitest.

Create nuxt-local-directory (ID 44): Nuxt + Supabase Postgres + MapLibre/OpenStreetMap + Meilisearch + AdSense. Structure: pages/, server/ (api/), composables/, components/, tests/. Fake adapters for search and maps.

Create eleventy-static-site (ID 45): Eleventy + Markdown/data files + AdSense + RSS + sitemap. Structure: src/ (posts/, includes/, data/), .eleventy.js, tests/. Minimal JS - focus on template configuration.

Create hugo-content-site (ID 46): Hugo + Markdown + AdSense + Pagefind + affiliate links. Structure: content/ (posts/), layouts/ (partials/, _default/), static/, assets/, package.json (for Pagefind), tests/. Hugo config in hugo.toml.
Create astro-recipe-site (ID 47): Astro + content collections + Recipe/HowTo schema.org + AdSense + RSS + sitemap. Follow astro-adsense-blog pattern with recipe-specific structured data.
Create astro-comparison-site (ID 48): Astro + content collections + structured data + affiliate links + AdSense. Comparison tables with pros/cons data model.
Create nextjs-coupon-site (ID 49): Next.js App Router + PostgreSQL/Drizzle + Meilisearch + Inngest + AdSense + affiliate tracking. Domain: Coupon, Store, Category, Click.
Create nextjs-real-estate-directory (ID 50): Next.js App Router + PostgreSQL/Drizzle + MapLibre/OpenStreetMap + Cloudflare R2 + AdSense. Domain: Property, Listing, Agent, Image.
Each starter MUST have: starter.json, package.json with exact-pinned deps, pnpm-lock.yaml, README.md, .env.example (if readsEnvironment), tests that pass, vitest.config.ts.
acceptance_criteria: All 13 Content/AdSense starter folders exist with correct structure
Each has a valid starter.json matching catalog/starters.json entry
Each has pnpm-lock.yaml generated by pnpm install
Each has tests that pass with vitest
pnpm catalog:validate passes for these starters
verification: Run pnpm install in each new starter to confirm lockfile validity
Run pnpm test in each starter to confirm tests pass
